name: Freshservice
summary: Freshservice has no free plan. Starter costs $19, Growth $49 and Pro $99 per agent a month on annual billing, with a 14-day trial. Incident management comes in every plan, while the service catalog and SLA management start on Growth. Enterprise is priced by quote. The terms make payments non-cancelable and non-refundable during a term.

facts.text: Freshservice lists incident management on Starter, and the service catalog and SLA management on Growth and above.
The 14-day trial gives access to all features, and new accounts get 3 free Day Passes for occasional agents.
After an account closes, customer data is available for export for 14 days, and Freshworks may keep it for up to three months before deletion.
Plans renew automatically unless a party gives written notice at least 30 days before the term ends.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Billed annually. Incident management, knowledge management, task management and a support portal

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Billed annually. Adds the service catalog, SLA management and on-call management

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Billed annually. Adds problem, change, major incident and release management

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Adds a sandbox and audit logs

hiddenCosts: The Freddy AI Copilot add-on costs $29 per agent a month and is sold for Pro and Enterprise only.
Day Passes for occasional agents beyond the 3 free ones start at $3.
IT asset management is licensed in Asset Units sold in packs of 500.

contract.cancellation: Payment obligations are non-cancelable and non-refundable except as the agreement allows, and users cannot be reduced or the plan downgraded during a term.
contract.dataExport: Data can be exported for 14 days after closure, if payments are current.
